interface.title: Calcium Imaging Dashboard (Calcium Dashboard – Unified Cell Processing System)
interface.field: Neuroscience – calcium imaging (one-photon miniscope / two-photon) longitudinal cell tracking
interface.stage_of_work: Post-segmentation curation: after CaImAn/Minian/MIN1PIPE source extraction, before downstream activity analysis
interface.what_it_is_for: Clean and merge segmented ROIs per session, register fields of view across imaging days, match the same neurons across sessions, and save everything to a sibling _curated database without touching the raw file.

data.note: The server preloaded examples/Mouse56_5sessions.mat (cohort 'Experimental', animal Mouse56). It has five sessions, Reward50pct_Session03–07, with 17/13/16/40/45 cells, 131 in total. Choosing the animal opened the Overview. According to the run's notes, saving wrote /work/app/examples/Mouse56_5sessions_curated.mat and the header switched to that file. No kept screen shows the full file name: in screens/070.webp it is cut off as 'Mouse56_5sessio…'. All cell, match and coherence counts below come from this run. The replay's numbers diverged after its own edits.

tree.general: Turn per-day automatic cell segmentations into a clean, co-registered, cross-day identity table of neurons
tree.specific: Curate Mouse56's five Reward50pct sessions: clean/merge ROIs, align FOVs to Session07, match cells across sessions, save a _curated .mat (the db-builder import step was not reachable)

children.general: Build a portable cell database from each segmentation pipeline's output
children.specific: db-builder import wizard (CaImAn/Minian/MIN1PIPE → HDF5). It is a separate app on port 8001, it was not running, and it was NOT REACHED in this run

children.general: Open the dataset and choose the subject
children.specific: Pick cohort and animal in the header

children.general: Choose one subject so all of its recording days load
children.specific: Select Animal = Mouse56 to list the 5 sessions and the combined overview (131 cells)

children.label: chose Mouse56 in the Animal dropdown

children.general: Clean the detected cells/ROIs within each recording
children.specific: Cell Cleaning & Merging tab on session Reward50pct_Session03

children.general: Inspect one recording's detected cells over its reference image
children.specific: Open Session03: Footprints Map beside its MIP, with zoom/pan kept in sync

children.label: scrolled the wheel over the Footprints Map to zoom (the MIP followed)

children.general: Look at quality-metric distributions to choose cut-offs
children.specific: Compute Quality Distributions (footprint area, temporal contrast, eccentricity) and Pairwise Distributions (centroid distance, temporal correlation, spatial overlap)

children.general: Flag cells that fail a quality rule, review them, and discard them
children.specific: Enable Min temporal contrast = 2, then Find & Select Candidates (9 selected in this run, traces shown), then Discard Selected (17 → 8 cells, 'Unsaved: cells')

children.general: Hand-pick fragments of one cell and combine them
children.specific: Drag an oval on the Footprints Map to select 4 adjacent ROIs, then Merge Selected (Session03 → 14 cells in this run; the replay's alert also reported 'New cell count: 14'). The run kept no outcome screen: 017 shows only a loading overlay

children.label: left-dragged an oval around a 4-ROI cluster
pressed Merge Selected (confirm accepted); result shown in the replay's screen

children.general: Automatically combine likely duplicates using similarity thresholds
children.specific: Run Auto-Merge: at defaults (10 px, r ≥ 0.80, 10% overlap) nothing merged; after loosening to 17 px and r ≥ −0.10 it merged 1 duplicate in this run (Session03 → 13 cells). The replay merged 2 (→ 12) after its own merge combined different cells

children.label: pressed Run Auto-Merge with default sliders (nothing merged; the outcome screen comes from the replay, because the run's 018 is a loading overlay)
dragged Min Temporal Corr slider to -0.10 and Distance limit to 17 px

children.general: Register all recordings into one common coordinate frame
children.specific: Session Alignment tab, reference Reward50pct_Session07

children.general: Automatically align every recording to a reference
children.specific: From Overview, Run Auto Alignment (Translation-only, Direct, MIP): all 5 sessions registered. Stack coherence Combined went 0.581 → 0.586 in this run (replay: 0.579 → 0.584). The results table shows mean ± std NCC

children.general: Check one recording's fit against the reference and correct it by hand
children.specific: Open Session03 to see the red/green overlay on Session07 (NCC 0.557 after auto alignment). With step 5 px, nudge right and rotate (dx 4.47 → 9.47, rot 2.5°, NCC fell to 0.545). Reset Current Alignment then returns the session to its UNALIGNED transform (NCC 0.539 in the replay), not to the auto-alignment result

children.label: pressed Reset Current Alignment (back to unaligned, NCC 0.539 per replay)

children.general: Try a different registration model on one recording
children.specific: Alignment Mode = Non-rigid (Deformable), which adds a Demons Smoothing slider; Run Auto Alignment for Session03 only (NCC 0.578 in this run; a new row in the results table). The replay did not confirm this

children.general: Search over registration settings and rank them by fit
children.specific: Open Parameters (Translation+Rigid × Direct+Sequential × MIP+Footprints, ref Session07); Run Alignment Grid Search (8 combos); sort by MIP NCC (best in this run: rigid/Sequential/MIP, 0.607). The replay did not confirm this

children.label: clicked the MIP NCC column header to sort

children.general: Link the same cell across recordings
children.specific: Multi-Session Matching tab (all sessions)

children.general: Run cross-session assignment to build identity tracks
children.specific: Execute Matching (Hungarian; Max distance 20 px, Min overlap 3%, cost weight 0.50, cosine similarity). This run gave 75 master cells, 35 matched, 40 unmatched, 46.7% multi-session coverage (replay: 76/33/43, 43.4%). The presence heatmap and tracked cell list filled in

children.general: Inspect one tracked identity across all recordings
children.specific: Tick Master Cell #40 (5/5 sessions) in the Tracked Cell List. It is highlighted on the centroid map, and Footprints Zoom overlays its 5 per-session footprints. BG set to MIP. The replay did not confirm this

children.general: Review the edited working data, then save it without overwriting the original
children.specific: Header working-copy controls (Undo, View: Working Copy / Raw Preview) and Save, which writes a sibling _curated .mat

children.general: Reverse an edit
children.specific: Header Undo reversed the Session03 discard: back to 17 cells and status 'Saved'

children.general: Compare the edited working data against the untouched original
children.specific: Switch View between Raw Preview (131 cells, Session03 = 17) and Working Copy (127 cells, Session03 = 13 after this run's edits; the replay showed 126/12 after its own edits)

children.general: Commit all edits to a new file next to the raw one
children.specific: Save changed the status from 'Unsaved: alignment, cells, matching' to 'Saved'. The File name is reported as Mouse56_5sessions_curated.mat, but it is cut off in screens/070.webp ('Mouse56_5sessio…'). The replay's Save had not finished, so this was not confirmed

features.name: Footprint map with oval lasso selection and a synced reference image
features.general: Pick cells on a 2-D image by dragging an ellipse, and zoom/pan it together with a side-by-side reference image; the picked set drives actions and plots elsewhere
features.specific: Footprints Map + MIP with SYNC ZOOM & PAN: left-drag an oval to select ROIs (Alt-click/Alt-drag deselects), scroll to zoom, right-drag to pan; selected cells show as red dots and feed Discard/Merge and Temporal Activity Traces
steps: Open a session or the Overview
Scroll to zoom (the MIP follows)
Left-drag an oval around ROIs to select them
Watch the selected ROIs' traces appear in Temporal Activity Traces
Press Discard Selected / Discard Unselected / Merge Selected
serves_tasks: Inspect one recording's detected cells over its reference image
Hand-pick fragments of one cell and combine them

features.name: Rule-based review candidates over quality histograms
features.general: Show histograms of per-cell quality metrics, turn on threshold rules, and auto-select the cells that fail for review, without deleting anything until the user confirms
features.specific: Cell Quality Distributions (footprint area, temporal contrast, eccentricity) + Find Quality Review Candidates checkboxes (Min/Max area, Min temporal contrast, Max eccentricity) → Find & Select Candidates → Discard Selected
steps: Press Compute Quality Distributions
Tick the rules to apply and set thresholds
Press Find & Select Candidates (alert reports the count)
Review the selected ROIs on the map and in traces
Press Discard Selected to stage removal
serves_tasks: Look at quality-metric distributions to choose cut-offs
Flag cells that fail a quality rule, review them, and discard them

features.name: Threshold-tuned duplicate auto-merge with pairwise distributions
features.general: Plot pairwise similarity distributions (distance, correlation, overlap), set three sliders, and automatically merge groups that meet all three thresholds; adjust and repeat
features.specific: Pairwise Metric Distributions + Auto-Merge Duplicates sliders (Distance limit px, Min Temporal Corr, Min Spatial Overlap %) → Run Auto-Merge; the alert reports merges per session
steps: Press Compute Pairwise Distributions
Set the Distance / Correlation / Overlap sliders
Press Run Auto-Merge and confirm
If nothing merged, loosen the thresholds and run again
serves_tasks: Automatically combine likely duplicates using similarity thresholds

features.name: Shared working copy with undo/redo, raw preview and a single save
features.general: Keep every edit in an in-memory working copy shared across views, with undo/redo, a toggle to view the untouched original, a status showing which kinds of change are pending, and one save that writes a new sibling file
features.specific: Header Undo/Redo, View: Working Copy / Raw Preview, status 'Unsaved: alignment, cells, matching', Save → *_curated.mat (the save-to-_curated step was not confirmed by the replay)
steps: Make edits in any tab (the status lists the unsaved domains)
Press Undo (or Ctrl+Z) to reverse the last edit
Switch View to Raw Preview to compare with the original
Press Save to write the _curated file; the status becomes 'Saved'
serves_tasks: Compare the edited working data against the untouched original
Commit all edits to a new file next to the raw one

features.name: Two-colour overlay image registration with manual nudge pad
features.general: Overlay a moving image (red) on a reference (green), run automatic registration with a chosen model, read the similarity score, and fine-tune with arrow/rotate/scale buttons at a chosen step size, or reset to the unaligned state
features.specific: Session Alignment: Reference panel + 'Session07: Green | Session03: Red' overlay with NCC; Alignment Mode (Translation / Rigid / Similarity / Non-rigid with Demons Smoothing), Strategy (Direct / Sequential), Source (MIP / Footprints Sum); Run Auto Alignment; Manual Alignment Tuning pad (1/5/10 px); Reset Current Alignment (returns to the unaligned transform, not the auto result)
steps: Pick a reference session and alignment mode
Press Run Auto Alignment (Overview = all sessions; a selected session = that one)
Read the overlay and the NCC / shift readout
Choose a step size and press nudge/rotate/scale buttons
Press Reset Current Alignment to return to the unaligned transform
serves_tasks: Automatically align every recording to a reference
Check one recording's fit against the reference and correct it by hand
Try a different registration model on one recording

features.name: Registration parameter grid search with a sortable results table
features.general: Tick combinations of method settings, run them all, and compare candidates in a sortable table of fit scores and transform values
features.specific: Parameters panel (Alignment Mode × Strategy × Source Image × Reference Session checkboxes) → Run Alignment Grid Search → Alignment Results table (MIP NCC, SF NCC, Disp, Acc dx/dy/Rot/Scale, Rel dx/dy), sortable by column; clicking a row did not apply that transform
steps: Press Parameters
Tick modes, strategies, sources and reference(s)
Press Run Alignment Grid Search
Click a column header (e.g. MIP NCC) to sort
serves_tasks: Search over registration settings and rank them by fit

features.name: Threshold-based cross-session matching with summary totals
features.general: Match cells across several recordings by optimal assignment under distance/overlap thresholds and a cost weight, then read totals of tracked, matched and unmatched identities and the multi-recording coverage
features.specific: Multi-Session Matching: sliders (Max Distance, Min Spatial Overlap, Cost Weight), Overlap Metric (Cosine / Jaccard), Execute Matching (Hungarian) → Tracked Centroids header with Total / Matched / Unmatched / coverage
steps: Open the Multi-Session Matching tab
Set the matching thresholds and overlap metric
Press Execute Matching
Read the totals and coverage
serves_tasks: Run cross-session assignment to build identity tracks

features.name: Identity-track browser: presence heatmap, track list and per-track footprint zoom
features.general: Browse identity tracks as a list and a presence heatmap (rows = identities, columns = recordings); selecting a track highlights it on a centroid map with a choice of background and overlays its per-recording footprints, and selected tracks can be merged or deleted by hand
features.specific: Cell Presence Heatmap + Tracked Cell List (e.g. Master Cell #40, 5/5 sessions) + Tracked Centroids BG radio (None/MIP/Spatial/Both) + Footprints Zoom; Merge Cells Across Sessions / Delete Selected Cell Groups are present but were not tried
steps: After matching, scan the presence heatmap and Tracked Cell List
Tick a master cell to highlight it on the centroid map
Read its overlaid per-session footprints in Footprints Zoom
Switch the BG radio to MIP for anatomical context
serves_tasks: Inspect one tracked identity across all recordings

features.name: Before/after stack-coherence panel for registration
features.general: Judge registration of a whole stack at once by comparing before and after composite images with MIP, footprint and combined coherence scores
features.specific: Session Alignment stack coherence: SF/MIP Before vs After composites with MIP / SF / Combined scores (Combined 0.581 → 0.586 in this run), plus a mean ± std NCC row in the results table
steps: Open the Session Alignment tab on the Overview
Note the Before coherence scores
Press Run Auto Alignment
Compare the After composites and scores with Before
serves_tasks: Automatically align every recording to a reference

features.name: Sessions-sequence list with per-session readouts
features.general: List a subject's recordings in order with per-recording readouts (cell count, and in alignment the shift and fit scores), and open any one for detailed work
features.specific: Sessions Sequence list (Reward50pct_Session03–07 with cell counts; shift and MIP/SF NCC in Session Alignment); click a session to open it, Overview for all. Reorder arrows and the red per-session button are present but were not tried
steps: Choose the animal to fill the list
Read the per-session cell counts or alignment readouts
Click a session to open it, or Overview for all
serves_tasks: Choose one subject so all of its recording days load
Inspect one recording's detected cells over its reference image
Check one recording's fit against the reference and correct it by hand
